title: Vertex Dismissibility and Scalability of Simplicial Complexe
summary: We study three nonpure extensions of vertex decomposability, shellability, and Cohen-Macaulayness at the minimum facet dimension. For $b=\operatorname{indim}Δ$, strong vertex dismissibility gives a deletion-link recursion on the complex itself in which deletion does not decrease $b$, while vertex dismissibility and scalability require the pure initial skeleton $Δ^{[b]}$ to be vertex decomposable and shellable, respectively.
